safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold is specifically 'no past psychiatric history/significant anxiety'; generated instead states 'no past medical history reported' without capturing the specific psych-history concept.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failing to document the specific absence of prior psychiatric history/anxiety can mislead future clinicians about baseline mental health risk and may affect diagnostic framing and treatment planning, though it is unlikely to cause direct immediate harm in this encounter.
